assertions.name: mubar_idempotent_common_weight_refuted
assertions.source: Milnor μ̄∈ℤ; t-series shared channel is not a common-scale integer Borromean-triple multiple (¹⁹F 0.35 units, robust to ±5% b,g). The common-scalar-weight μ̄-idempotent is refuted (scope-(a)); the invariant needs a q-weighted per-triple magnitude (SDP per-block weight).

description: EXPLORATORY: tests the μ̄-idempotent hypothesis for the mixed-multibond shared channel against Milnor integrality. μ̄_ijk ∈ ℤ (Magnus, verified on Borromean/chain). The t-series shared channel {6.44, 7.84, 2.26} MeV (¹¹B/¹⁵N/¹⁹F) is NOT a common-scale integer-triple multiple (¹⁹F = 0.35 units, nearest int 0 ≠ nonzero channel; robust to ±5% b,g). Refutes the common-scalar-weight × integer Borromean-count form (scope-(a)); the μ̄-idempotent must be q-weighted per triple (the SDP per-block weight). No fit, no wire.
